title: Jab kabhi geerat -e- insaan ka sawaal aata hai
body:
1. jab kabhi geerat -e- insaan ka sawaal aata hai
binte zehra tere parde ka khayal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2.darmiya lashoun ke tanha nazar aate hain hussain
jab ke ashoor ke suraj pe zawal aata hain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. mouth kis sounch main hain lashaye akber pa khadi
kya payamber ki jawani ka khayal aata hain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. badke abbas kaleje se lagalete hain
jab sakina ki yateemi ka khayaal aata hain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. khoon bhara kurta utha leti hain badkar zainab
jab ke darbar main luta huwa maal aata hain
